Generated from active production TypeScript and Vue script blocks. Tests, historical journeys, generated declarations and vendor archives are excluded.

Each source folder has a `REFERENCE.md` next to the code. Those pages index every module and executable function, including private helpers, accessors, constructors and anonymous callbacks. Signatures preserve authored types; inferred return types are explicitly identified. Source JSDoc supplies behavioral contracts. Call sites and explicit throws are static observations, not guarantees of purity, complete transitive errors or runtime execution order.
